audio.title: Audio excerpt
audio.help: The file is played in steps during the blind test (1 s, then 5 s, then 20 s), always from the start point. Pick a recognisable passage of at least 20 seconds.
audio.empty: No excerpt. Import a file (mp3 or ogg, {max} max) or search for a track.
audio.useCurrentPosition: Use the playback position as start point
audio.tooShort: Less than 20 seconds after the start point: the last blind test step will stop early.
audio.rights: I certify I have the right to play this file
audio.rightsHelp: QuizzUP themes: royalty-free sound with a commercial licence only. Your centre's themes: the excerpt is played under your responsibility (your venue's music licence).

search.label: Title or artist
search.idle: Enter a title or an artist, then submit the search.
search.empty: No track found. Try other words.

errors.playFailed: This excerpt cannot be played in the browser.

errors.audioTypeInvalid: Unsupported format: choose an mp3 or ogg file.
errors.rightsRequired: Tick the rights statement to upload this file.
errors.previewFailed: This file cannot be played in the browser.
errors.uploadFailed: The question is saved, but the audio excerpt was not uploaded: {reason}
errors.measuring: Please wait: the file duration is still being read.
errors.startFailed: The question and its file are saved, but the start point could not be. Try again.

apiErrors.question_media_invalid_file: the file content is not mp3 or ogg.
apiErrors.question_media_not_found: no file found for this question.
apiErrors.invalid_query: the search is invalid (2 characters minimum).
apiErrors.media_provider_unavailable: the excerpt service is not answering, try again in a moment.
apiErrors.question_media_provider_track_not_found: this track no longer exists at the provider.
apiErrors.question_media_provider_no_preview: this track has no excerpt available.
apiErrors.question_kind_media_invalid: a true / false or estimate question only accepts text or an image: audio and video are for multiple-choice questions.
apiErrors.forbidden: you are not allowed to edit this question.

audioEffect.label: Excerpt effect
audioEffect.hint: Changes how the excerpt is played in the blind test. A reversed or slowed excerpt is harder to recognise.

errors.audio_effect_requires_audio: An effect only applies to an audio question.

errors.trueFalseAnswers: A true / false question has exactly two answers, « Vrai » and « Faux », with one correct.
errors.estimateAnswers: An estimate has 3 or 4 ranges starting with a number (e.g. « Moins de 100 », « 100 à 199 »), with one correct.
errors.kindMediaInvalid: A true / false or estimate question only accepts text or an image: audio and video are for multiple-choice questions.

kindRules.true_false: True / false: two answers « Vrai » and « Faux », one correct.
kindRules.estimate: Estimate: 3 or 4 ranges starting with a number (« Moins de 100 », « 100 à 199 », « 1 000 ou plus »), one correct. Entry order does not matter.
